metadata.title: Splay ostracism on ferroelectric nematic shells
metadata.abstract: Ostracism was the practice in use in Athens and other ancient Greek cities to send into exile citizens whose influence was deemed to be dangerous. Quite similarly, splay ostracism is here the approximation that bans splay distortion from thin films of ferroelectric nematic liquid crystals on a curved shell in space. This reduces to a mere geometric problem the quest for equilibria of director vortexes and the walls isolating them, as splay ostracism requires the director field lines to be everywhere orthogonal to systems of geodesics on the shell. Consequences of this theorem are explored for shells with Gaussian curvature of either sign. The resulting quasi static dynamics reveals both cases where walls escape from the shell and cases where they are trapped on it, with possibly different reflections on the vortex dynamics.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 对空间中弯曲壳面上的铁电向列液晶薄膜采用禁止splay畸变的近似。该约束要求指向场的场线处处正交于壳面上的测地线族，从而把涡旋及隔离壁的平衡转化为几何问题。作者讨论Gauss曲率不同符号壳面上的结果，准静态动力学中可出现壁逃离壳面或被捕获的不同情形。
techniques: 壳面测地线与正交指向场
涡旋隔离壁的几何平衡
曲率符号与准静态动力学
analysis.breakthrough: 给出受约束液晶指向场与测地线族的关系，并用于解释隔离壁的不同运动方式。
analysis.limitations: 结论建立在禁止splay的近似模型及准静态描述上；摘要未给完整能量、边界条件或一般动力学定理。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
